cards.meaning: Classic test builtin ( [ is a synonym for test )
cards.notes: Status 0 = true, 1 = false. Need spaces: [ -f file ]. Unquoted spaces can cause “too many arguments”.
File must exist for these to be true (and have the matching property).

cards.meaning: Extended test — a keyword, one element
cards.notes: && || < > legal inside. Safer with spaces than [ ].
Non-zero value → status 0. Value 0 → status 1 (opposite of C booleans for exit status).

cards.meaning: Branch when a command list returns 0
cards.notes: Can test any command, not only [. Ends with fi.
Each arm ends with ;;. Statement ends with esac.

cards.meaning: AND list — run next only if previous succeeded (0)
OR list — run next only if previous failed
Do something if the last command failed
cards.notes: Read $? immediately — the next command overwrites it.

cards.meaning: Word-split trap vs safe extended test
cards.notes: [ can become “too many arguments”. [[ treats it as one test.
